coordinator_quality_adjudication.reason: The fresh run is valid evidence but demonstrates material V4 false negatives against pre-existing located target-reader failures. A valid fresh AI reader PASS cannot override unresolved located human target-reader evidence.

false_negative_analysis.finding: The evaluator treated a representative terse triage exchange as strongly human and passed the emotional scene, but the target-reader complaint concerns recurrent scene-surface skeletonization across the manuscript rather than the local truth of one exchange.
false_negative_analysis.root_cause: RX-R001 was specified too locally and did not test cross-scene dramatization-surface density.

false_negative_analysis.finding: The evaluator passed the early warning speech that packages known mission context, public spread, reward and arrival evidence into one polished unit, directly missing the located target-reader natural-speech failure.
false_negative_analysis.root_cause: V4-G6N remained too permissive when a speech had a valid scene goal.

false_negative_analysis.finding: The evaluator accepted a supporting character's return because an old relationship motive and spatial feasibility existed, even though those facts already existed when the character previously chose to withdraw.
false_negative_analysis.root_cause: V4-G1M did not require a new post-withdrawal decision delta for reversal of an explicit exit choice.

false_negative_analysis.finding: The evaluator proved structural option compression and therefore passed the climax, while the located target-reader evidence reports very low felt climax intensity.
false_negative_analysis.root_cause: RX-R004 incorrectly used option compression as a proxy for experienced voltage.

false_negative_analysis.finding: The evaluator successfully formed working hypotheses around the black-arrow chain, yet the target-reader evidence reports little desire to discover the answer.
false_negative_analysis.root_cause: RX-R005 incorrectly equated hypothesis availability with curiosity charge.
